## Key Vocabulary


::: {.vocab-box}
**Evolution** — The change in populations over time through natural selection
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Natural selection** — The process where organisms better adapted to their environment survive and reproduce
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Fossil record** — The preserved remains of ancient organisms in rock layers
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Radiometric dating** — Using radioactive decay to determine the age of rocks and fossils
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Geological time** — The vast scales of time over which Earth and life have changed
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Ancestor** — An organism from which other organisms descend
:::
